messages:
Aisha: FYI — ZenLedger just escalated. After yesterday's rollout their invoice generator started outputting empty line-item rows (QTY: 0) for some invoices. They say a VERY tiny change to their template now breaks it. :warning:
Priya: They pasted a repro. Root request uses model redwood-large-v2. They said the only diff is adding a trailing comment in the template, like changing `{{items}}` to `{{items}}\n-- end` and then line items vanish.
Aisha: Attaching the trimmed curl they sent (API key redacted):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v2","prompt":"Invoice for Acme Corp:\n{{items}}\n-- end","max_tokens":400}'
```
Response they got (partial):
```
Invoice for Acme Corp:
QTY: 0
Description: N/A
Total: $0.00
```
Ken: Can you paste the original prompt (without the `-- end`) and the full response, plus request_id if present? Also which deployment (hosted vs dedicated) and model_variant?
Priya: Original prompt was `Invoice for Acme Corp:\n{{items}}` — everything worked. They supplied request_id `r-0a1b2c3d` from their logs. This was on hosted API in us-west-2. No auth errors.
ops-bot: Alert: support case created (#CS-4129). Noted increased retries from the customer's SDK — billing spike observed (5x request rate) between 2026-02-25T14:00Z and 2026-02-25T14:10Z.
Liam: Interesting. Two hypotheses: 1) subtle tokenization/placeholder boundary change after kernel update; 2) our new prompt-parsing canonicalizer treats trailing punctuation/comments as a control sequence and collapses the `items` expansion. Can you share tokenization for both prompt variants?
Aisha: Tokenized both with the CLI tool and attached diffs. Short summary: the extra `\n-- end` added 3 tokens and shifted the subsequent token offsets. They sent a minimal repro that fails 100% of the time.
Ken: I'll try to repro on staging with redwood-large-v2@2026-03-01 (pre-rollout) and the current canary. If it's deterministic we can pin customers to old variant quickly.
Priya: Customer is pretty upset — says production invoices are wrong for some customers. They requested rollback or hotfix.
Elaine: Product: please hold the wider rollout for the next wave. If this is a breaking behavioral regression on templates we should freeze. :eyes:
Sam: Can we get the exact model config used for hosted variant? batch settings, quantization, and canonicalizer flag? Those are typical levers for this class of regressions.
Ken: Confirmed: can reproduce locally with canary image. Repro steps: 1) call the API with prompt variant A (works). 2) call with prompt variant B (trailing comment) -> items empty. Will capture deterministic diff and file a bug.
Liam: Quick mitigation: try adding an explicit separator token in the template, e.g., `\n<ITEMS_END>` after `{{items}}`. That might avoid canonicalizer folding. Share this with customer as a temporary workaround.
Priya: I'll send the workaround and offer to pin them to pre-rollout variant. Also asked for a copy of their full prompt context (system messages, examples).
ops-bot: Noted: throttling policy applied to customer due to retry surge; see billing team for credits.
Ken: Filing ENG ticket ENG-7421 with repro, request_id, and failing/working prompt pairs. Assigning to @Liam to investigate canonicalizer change.
Aisha: Customer wanted ETA. I said we'll try to provide fix or rollback within 4 hours and keep them updated every 30m.
Liam: Preliminary root cause looks like an unintended interaction between the prompt canonicalizer and our new whitespace squeeze optimization. Will update after initial debug. :thumbsup:
Elaine: Thanks all. If this escalates, we'll spin up an incident channel. For now, keep thread updates short and paste logs only when asked.
